email.subject: Quick fix for CoastAir Works' site
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I checked CoastAir Works' site. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next HVAC company; and there are no reviews showing, which makes new visitors hesitate before calling.

The page title also doesn't mention Harbor Falls or HVAC, which can hurt how you show up in local searches.

I fix these for a flat fee, no ongoing contract. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough this week where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
